_note: Which committed runs scripts/build_scoreboard.py puts on docs/scoreboard.html, newest first. Every number on the page is recomputed from each dir's results.jsonl + grades.jsonl (swebench_outcome) or analysis.json (cost_truth). `date` and `versions` are run metadata copied from the run's report.md notes and git history; arm_meta in the rows wins when present. Add a dir here after a run lands; an arm with no rows shows 'pending run'.

runs.note: plain rows are reused from swebench-outcome-300 (same model, effort and tasks), as that run's report.md says
